detail.title: NC160 Laptop Cooling Pad with Mobile Holder
detail.overview: The Ant Esports NC160 is a laptop cooling pad built with two quiet 125mm fans running at 1000 RPM, keeping laptops up to 15.6 inches cool during demanding work or gaming sessions. Its large, sturdy metal mesh design adds strength and cooling ability while silicone pads ensure a stable grip on the surface below, and 5 adjustable height positions let you set the perfect angle for typing or viewing. A hideable phone holder on the side frees up your hands during calls or meetings without taking extra desk space, and two USB ports let you charge accessories directly from the pad. Two baffles keep the laptop securely in place, preventing it from sliding or slipping off during use.
